items.title: Spider Listening to a Bell
items.alt: A brown spider viewed from above spreads eight jointed legs beside a golden handbell with a wooden handle.
items.description: A brown spider viewed from above spreads eight jointed legs beside a golden handbell with a wooden handle. Useful for sound vocabulary cards.
